description.value: The Sausage Factory is a long-established butcher and deli in Smithers, BC, operating since 1984 and now under new ownership. The shop specializes in house-crafted sausages made weekly, locally sourced hormone-free meats from the Bulkley Valley, and an extensive selection of imported and specialty cheeses. Touring cyclists passing through Smithers will find a solid resupply option for deli meats, smoked products, freezer packs, and quick heat-and-serve meals.
